reviewer: assistant actual view_image inspection of all3pages/17selectedcontexts
observations: All 9600 training views were scanned for support/color descriptors. Raw Fence support >=512 pixels occurs in the four Town01 route groups; the four Town03 groups have none at that threshold.
Selected max-support/warm/bright-neutral train contexts show concrete barriers and metal mesh; validation representatives show white picket and wooden panels.
Warm color is insufficient to identify wood: the warm train selections still include metal mesh or distant small structures.
limits: Automated descriptors scanned all train views, but only17selected contexts were visually inspected. This does not prove every possible wooden fence is absent; no automatic material annotation, new data approval or model acceptance.
